These FAQs cover service areas, timelines, installer details, and what to expect during your project with HomeStar Windows & Doors. What areas of Utah does HomeStar serve? We serve homeowners across Salt Lake County, Utah County, Davis County, and Summit County . If you are located outside of those counties, a travel fee based on your location will be added. How long does a typical window replacement project take? Most projects are completed in one day. Each window takes about 30 to 60 minutes to remove and replace, depending on size and accessibility. Do you use subcontractors for installation? No. Our installers work for us full time, which allows us to control quality and back every installation with a lifetime warranty. How much does window replacement in Utah usually cost? Pricing varies based on window style, size, and energy package. Many projects fall in the mid to upper four figures for partial replacements, and higher for full home upgrades. Your free in-home consultation includes a detailed, digital proposal emailed to you. Is financing available for window and door projects? Yes. We offer financing options for qualified customers to spread payments over time. Your consultant can walk you through current plans and help you apply during your visit, so you know exactly what monthly payments could look like. Will there be a lot of mess during installation? Our crew protect floors and furniture with drop cloths, remove construction debris, and vacuum work areas before they leave. We also haul away your old windows and doors, so you are not left with a pile of materials to deal with. Ready To Upgrade Your Windows & Doors? Expert installation, in-house crews, and a lifetime workmanship warranty. HomeStar makes every project seamless and stress-free.
